node.statement: The exact contract of lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation enumerates the output facts: existence of an error-improved map v_R, d_R <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_R, the unit estimate, conditional preservation of bijectivity, and unchanged source, target, and amplification form. None is an extended-inclusion assertion, and no registered definition identifies error-improved map or a recorded map-defect number with such an assertion. Thus the antecedent required by the former monotonicity step is absent. Separately, def-extended-delta-inclusion refers to a base delta-homomorphism without stating its error inequalities, so those exact inputs also do not establish homomorphism-tolerance monotonicity. These are independent missing bridges, not consequences of the numerical inequality.
